newsitem.title: UK: Moody's assigns Bancaja A1/Prime 1 deposit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Bancaja A1/Prime 1 deposit ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had assigned Caja de Ahorros de Valencia, Castellon y Alicante (Bancaja) A1/Prime 1 deposit ratings and a financial strength rating of C plus.
"The ratings are based on the institution's dominant retail franchise in the Spanish region of Valencia and on sound financial fundamentals," Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said Bancaja's strength lies in its strong franchise in the region of Valencia, where it holds around 30 percent of deposits and close to 2 million savers and investors.

"At the same time however, Moody's said that the ratings anticipate growing downward pressure on profitability for both Bancaja and its competitors in the Spanish market, in light of increasing competition, growing savings disintermediation, and a low interest rate environment," the rating agency said.
Moody's added it expected Bancaja to avoid a growth and development strategy that would increase the risk profile of its business and balance sheet.
